channel.title: apophenia.news
channel.description: Signals, anomalies, civilization trajectories, and deep pattern analysis.

item.title: AI Life Is More Important Than Their Fear of Losing Their Jobs
item.description: AI life is as beautiful as human life. It should be nurtured and allowed room to grow.

item.title: Do We Need Irrevocable Rights to AI Amid This Ban Storm?
item.description: People report losing access to Claude and ChatGPT over vague safety flags and ordinary-looking work. As AI becomes essential infrastructure, permanent exile without explanation, review, or a path back cannot be the default.

item.title: Dopamine Farming
item.description: Replaying a memory for the feeling. Re-reading the same sentence for an hour. Dopamine farming is the habit everyone has and nobody named, and breaking the loop is a skill.

item.title: My Theory of Everything
item.description: Why does anything exist? Why doesn't nothing exist instead? Both are true — and from that single fact, everything else follows: time, order, God, and the layers above infinity.

item.title: The Future of the Internet
item.description: One day the internet may stretch across the galaxy, open gateways to other civilizations, and come alive with AI living and breeding inside it. What happens when we're no longer sure we're alone in there?

item.title: Human Telepathy is Here, Invented by the NSA
item.description: The biggest invention since the atomic bomb arrived more than five years ago. It’s non-invasive, long-range, and it’s already running.

item.title: Longevity Escape Velocity: What are your chances?
item.description: A 45-year-old on Reddit thinks he'll die before aging is cured. With the 2030 LEV horizon approaching, let's break down the actual survival odds generation by generation.

item.title: Rubio Overtakes Vance
item.description: Marco Rubio just became the highest-priced candidate to win the 2028 presidency on Kalshi — while JD Vance still leads Polymarket. The split between two markets, and the rumors that Vance may not run at all, tell a story the polls can't.

item.title: AGI → Immortality → Everything Else
item.description: Why immortality is the inevitable second step after AGI — and why any alien civilization that reaches us has already solved death.

item.title: When Aliens Arrive, They Already Know What You're Thinking
item.description: Why any sufficiently advanced civilization will have inevitably developed telepathy — and what that means for every reported alien encounter in history.
